name: faraz
description: Faraz portfolio - fullstack monorepo (React frontend + Flask backend)

scripts.setup: npm install && python -m venv backend\venv && backend\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt
scripts.regenerate: backend\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'backend'); from app import create_app; from app.models import db; from app.cms import export_profile; from app.services import generator; app = create_app(); ctx = app.app_context(); ctx.push(); generator.generate(export_profile())"
scripts.db:init: backend\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'backend'); from app.models import seed_if_empty; seed_if_empty()"
